title: Miguel R.
text:
I’m a software engineer focused on data science — bridging the gap between predictive modeling and the scalable, user-facing applications that put those models to work.
My background combines full-stack development (React, React Native, TypeScript, and versatile backend work) with hands-on modeling in Python. I’ve architected data-heavy applications end to end: processing large volumes of information efficiently and presenting it intuitively. I particularly enjoy geospatial work — turning complex datasets into fast, interactive maps that make geographic insight obvious at a glance.
I care about clean, reusable code — whether I’m engineering zero-latency frontend deployments for machine learning models or squeezing performance out of an existing system.
